dialogues.speaker: Roshana
dialogues.text: I don't actually like it, but I don't hate it either.

dialogues.speaker: Roshana
dialogues.text: Overall, it's better than when I was with the Eremites, because I don't have to deal with those stiff researchers anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Roshana
dialogues.text: Ha, it's funny that even the power of alcohol is greater than knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Roshana
dialogues.text: Wait and see — a glass of something stronger is enough for those researchers to abandon rules.
